title: Frozen Flesh: Flicker
description: Adds a weather system for It_Craves's Frozen Flesh modpack via SmushyTaco's Solar Apocalypse and Jaggwagg's Frozen Apocalypse.
body:
Adds a weather system to [It\_Crave](https://modrinth.com/user/It_Craves)'s Frozen Flesh modpack, by allowing the Solar Apocalypse from [SmushyTaco](https://modrinth.com/user/SmushyTaco)'s [Solar Apocalypse](https://modrinth.com/mod/solar-apocalypse/versions) mod and the Frozen Apocalypse from [Jaggwagg](https://modrinth.com/user/Jaggwagg)'s [Frozen Apocalypse](https://modrinth.com/mod/frozen-apocalypse) undefinedmod to cycle in phases.

Supports compatability with [AlcatrazEscapee](https://modrinth.com/user/alcatrazEscapee)'s [Primal Winter](https://modrinth.com/mod/primal-winter) and [TheAdubbz](https://modrinth.com/user/Adubbz)' [Tough As Nails](https://modrinth.com/mod/tough-as-nails).
